options.text: A 3 year old girl developed a fever for 1 day followed by onset of pruritic vesicular rash which crusted. She is known to be in contact with a 3 year old boy who has not had any immunisations. What is the most appropriate management for the 3 year old boy?
Immunisation * varicella vaccine is recommended for post-exposure prophylaxis within 72 hrs or up to 120 hrs for health unvaccinated people aged over 12 months without evidence of immunity (CDC 2012)
